mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_FEEDBACK_M (SCREEN_NM, SCREEN_URL, KIND_CD, CONTENT, EMPLY_ID) VALUES (NULLIF(#{SCREEN_NM}, ''), NULLIF(#{SCREEN_URL}, ''), #{KIND_CD}, #{CONTENT}, #{EMPLY_ID})
mapper.select: SELECT F.FB_SQ, F.SCREEN_NM, F.KIND_CD, F.CONTENT, F.EMPLY_ID, DATE_FORMAT(F.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REG_DT , F.STATUS_CD, F.PLAN_TXT, F.EST_TXT, F.DEV_NOTE, F.REJECT_REASON, F.ACT_EMPLY_ID, DATE_FORMAT(F.ACT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS ACT_DT, F.UPD_SQ, F.SEEN_YN , F.SPEC_HTML IS NOT NULL AS HAS_SPEC , F.EMPLY_ID LIMIT 1) AS EMPLY_NM , F.ACT_EMPLY_ID LIMIT 1) AS ACT_NM FROM TB_EEP_FEEDBACK_M F ORDER BY F.FB_SQ DESC
SELECT F.FB_SQ, F.SCREEN_NM, F.CONTENT, F.STATUS_CD, F.PLAN_TXT, F.SPEC_HTML FROM TB_EEP_FEEDBACK_M F WHERE F.FB_SQ = #{FB_SQ}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_FEEDBACK_M SET STATUS_CD = #{STATUS_CD}, DEV_NOTE = IF(#{STATUS_CD} = 'ING', #{DEV_NOTE}, DEV_NOTE), REJECT_REASON = IF(#{STATUS_CD} = 'REJECT', #{REJECT_REASON}, NULL) , ACT_EMPLY_ID = #{ACT_EMPLY_ID}, ACT_DT = NOW(), SEEN_YN = IF(EMPLY_ID = #{ACT_EMPLY_ID}, 'Y', 'N') WHERE FB_SQ = #{FB_SQ} AND STATUS_CD <> 'DONE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_FEEDBACK_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} AND SEEN_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_FEEDBACK_M SET SEEN_YN = 'Y' WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} AND SEEN_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT U.UPD_SQ, U.TITLE, U.SCREENS, U.COMMIT_ID, U.FB_SQ, DATE_FORMAT(U.DEPLOY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DEPLOY_DT , F.EMPLY_ID LIMIT 1) AS FB_EMPLY_NM FROM TB_EEP_UPDATE_H U LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_FEEDBACK_M F ON F.FB_SQ = U.FB_SQ ORDER BY U.UPD_SQ DESC LIMIT ${LIMIT}

SELECT U.UPD_SQ, U.TITLE, U.SCREENS, U.CHANGED_TXT, U.TESTS_TXT, U.CAUTIONS_TXT, U.SPEC_HTML, U.COMMIT_ID, U.FB_SQ, DATE_FORMAT(U.DEPLOY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS DEPLOY_DT , F.CONTENT AS FB_CONTENT, F.SCREEN_NM AS FB_SCREEN, DATE_FORMAT(F.REG_DT, '%m-%d %H:%i') AS FB_REG_DT, DATE_FORMAT(F.ACT_DT, '%m-%d') AS FB_ACT_DT, F.DEV_NOTE , F.EMPLY_ID LIMIT 1) AS FB_EMPLY_NM , F.ACT_EMPLY_ID LIMIT 1) AS FB_ACT_NM FROM TB_EEP_UPDATE_H U LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_FEEDBACK_M F ON F.FB_SQ = U.FB_SQ WHERE U.UPD_SQ = #{UPD_SQ}
